retrievalProfile.description: A desaturated, blue-toned close-up portrait featuring a central subject with hands covering the face, framed by a stark black background and top-aligned serif text.
excludeWhen: sans-serif or modern display fonts are preferred

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key photograph of a bald figure from the chest up, with hands tightly clasped over the lower face. The image is processed with a heavy blue-grey desaturation, leaving deep black shadows and cool highlights. Text is positioned at the very top edge, spanning the width.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a void-like black background
Hands acting as a textural and emotional focal point in the lower half
Typography balanced across the top margin to frame the head
Cool blue highlights contrasting with deep neutral shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, medium close-up, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The interlocking fingers and knuckles in the center-foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top text, moves down the smooth curve of the head, and rests on the textured detail of the hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space surrounding the subject on the left, right, and top edges.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Desaturated steel blue for skin highlights and midtones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely low saturation; high value contrast between the subject and the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical serif with moderate stroke contrast.

composition.relationshipToImage: separate from subject, placed in negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in different cases (lowercase for primary, uppercase for secondary) to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Classical proportions and elegant serifs match the somber tone.
Highly legible at smaller sizes with a professional, clean serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast, desaturated blue-grey photograph of a man's head and shoulders against a black background, with his hands clasped over his face. Focus on skin texture and cool highlights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of white serif text at the very top of the frame, using lowercase for the first half and all-caps for the second half, spaced to the left and right corners respectively.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly desaturated blue and black?
Is the text placed at the extreme top edge?
Are the hands the primary textural element?
Is the background a solid, deep black?

mustRedesign: Any specific tattoos or logos on the hands
Specific facial features if they are identifiable
postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black background without noise
Verify text is legible against the dark top edge
Ensure the blue tint is uniform across the subject
Confirm the hands are correctly rendered with realistic interlocking fingers
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-contrast portrait + apply heavy blue desaturation + place white serif text at the top margin + surround with black negative space.
